tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

14	
15	- **YAML front matter**：一种从静态博客（Jekyll、Hugo）流行起来的约定——markdown 文件最顶部用一行 `---` 开始、再一行 `---` 结束，中间放一段 YAML 键值对元数据，正文跟在后面。olmOCR 借用这个格式让 VLM 在正文之前汇报页面元信息（语言、旋转、是否表格等）。
16	- **YAML 的「挪威问题」**：PyYAML 实现的是 YAML 1.1，会把裸写的 `no`、`No`、`NO`、`on`、`off` 等直接解析成布尔值 `False`/`True` 而不是字符串。所以 `primary_language: no`（本意可能是挪威语）到了 Python 里会变成 `False`。本讲会看到 olmOCR 专门为这件事写了防御代码。
17	- **dataclass 运行时内省**：`dataclasses.fields(SomeClass)` 能在运行时拿到字段名列表和每个字段的类型对象；`typing.get_origin` / `get_args` 能把 `Optional[str]` 拆开看——`get_origin(Optional[str])` 是 `typing.Union`，`get_args(Optional[str])` 是 `(str, NoneType)`。本讲的类型转换逻辑完全建立在这两个内省工具上。

91	[olmocr/pipeline.py:179-182](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L179-L182) 把 `guided_regex` 设为一条精确描述输出形状的正则（`---\nprimary_language: (?:[a-z]{2}|null)\n...` 两个字母语言码或 null、布尔四选、旋转度四选、结尾要么封口要么带正文）。也就是说：**生成端用正则约束形状，解析端再用严格校验兜底**，双保险。即便如此，解析仍可能抛异常，而 [olmocr/pipeline.py:228-230](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L228-L230) 的宽 `except Exception` 会把它变成 `return None`——即「本页本次尝试失败」，交给 u2-l6 要讲的重试机制。解析失败不会炸掉整条流水线。

151	### 4.2 _extract_front_matter_and_text：字符串切分与 YAML 容错
152	
153	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
154	
155	这一步解决的问题是：**从一整个字符串里，把「元数据头」和「正文」切开**。它不用任何 markdown 解析库，纯手工做前缀检查 + 定界符搜索 + 一次 `yaml.safe_load`，总共十几行。理解它的关键是看懂每个魔法数字（4、4）对应的字符偏移。
156	
157	它还是整条链路的「容错阀」：无论输入是「没有 front matter」「YAML 写坏了」还是「定界符没闭合」，它都不抛异常，而是统一回退成 `(空字典, 整段原文当正文)`——把「报不报错」的决定权交给下一节的 `_parse_front_matter`。
158	
159	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
160	
161	输入字符串的字符布局（正常情况）：
162	
163	```text
164	索引:  0    1    2    3    4 ..................... e ............. e+4
165	字符:  '-'  '-'  '-'  '\n' 'primary_language: en\n...' '\n' '-' '-' '-' '\n正文...'
166	      └──── 开启定界符 "---\n" ────┘└────── YAML 内容 ──────┘└─ 关闭定界符 "\n---" ─┘└─正文─┘
167	                                     content[4:e]                  content[e+4:]
168	```
169	
170	流程（对应源码逐行）：
171	
172	1. 前置判断：字符串必须以 `---\n` 开头（三个减号紧跟换行），否则视为没有 front matter。
173	2. 从索引 4 起向后找子串 `\n---`，得到结束位置 \( e \)（`find` 返回的是 `\n` 的位置）。找不到则视为没有 front matter。
174	3. 切分：YAML 段 = \( s[4:e] \)，正文 = \( s[e+4:] \) 再 `.strip()`（+4 是跳过 `\n---` 这四个字符）。
175	4. `yaml.safe_load(YAML 段) or {}`：解析结果为 `None`（空段）时兜底成空字典。
176	5. 任何 `yaml.YAMLError`：记 warning，落到统一回退分支。
177	6. 回退分支（无头/未闭合/YAML 坏）：返回 `({}, 整段原文.strip())`。
178	
179	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
180	
181	[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:37-53](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L37-L53) 是完整实现：`startswith("---\n")` 做前缀检查；`markdown_content.find("\n---", 4)` 找闭合定界符，搜索起点 4 恰好跳过开头的 `---\n`；两处切片 `[4:end_index]` 与 `[end_index + 4 :]` 分别取出 YAML 文本与正文；`yaml.safe_load(...) or {}` 把空解析兜成空字典；`except yaml.YAMLError` 只捕获 YAML 语法错误（记 warning 后落到函数末尾的回退返回），其余异常照常向外抛。
182	
183	三个要点：
184	
185	- **搜索起点为什么是 4**：避免把开头定界符自身牵连进匹配。副作用是「空 front matter」（`---\n` 紧跟 `---\n`）找不到闭合定界符，整体回退为「无 front matter」——后续 `_parse_front_matter` 会因缺字段报错。这是可接受的行为：空元数据本来就不合法。
186	- **`or {}` 的必要性**：`yaml.safe_load("")` 返回 `None` 而不是 `{}`，不兜底的话下游对它调 `.keys()` 会崩。
187	- **第一个 `\n---` 即视为结束**：如果 YAML 值内部恰好出现行首 `---`，会被误判为闭合——配合生成端的 `guided_regex` 约束，实际不会发生。
188	
189	配套单测印证了三种边界（见 [tests/test_dataloader.py:658-712](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/tests/test_dataloader.py#L658-L712)）：正常解析（`test_parse_yaml_front_matter` 断言 `page_data` 是 `PageResponse` 且 `natural_text` 等于正文）；无 front matter 且指定了目标类时报 `ValueError`（`test_no_front_matter`）；YAML 写坏时，不指定目标类的解析器返回空字典而不抛错（`test_malformed_yaml`，`page_data == {}`）——正好演示了「提取层容错、组装层严格」的分工。

248	### 4.3 _parse_front_matter：类型转换、严格校验与 PageResponse 组装
249	
250	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
251	
252	这一步拿到 `(字典, 正文)`，要把它变成可信的 `PageResponse`。模型输出是「野外数据」：YAML 值可能是字符串 `"90"` 而不是整数、`primary_language` 可能被 YAML 解析成布尔 `False`（挪威问题）、可能少写一个字段、也可能自作主张多写一个字段。这一步就是海关：逐字段查验、必要时强行转换、不合格就整体拒收（抛 `ValueError`/`TypeError`），绝不带病放行。
253	
254	它对目标类几乎没有硬编码——字段清单和类型都来自 `dataclasses.fields()` 运行时内省，所以换任何 dataclass 都能工作（硬编码的例外只有 `PageResponse` 的 `natural_text` 特例，见下）。
255	
256	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
257	
258	对目标类的每个字段依次执行：
259	
260	```text
261	for 字段名, 字段类型 in fields(目标类):
262	    ├─ 是 PageResponse.natural_text？ → 取正文 text；text 为空串则置 None
263	    ├─ 字典里没有该字段？             → raise ValueError("Missing required field ...")
264	    └─ 按字段类型转换字典值：
265	         int 字段 且 值是 str         → int(value)          # "90" → 90
266	         bool 字段 且 值是 str        → value.lower()=="true" # "True"→True, "yes"→False
267	         Optional[str] 字段：
268	              值是 bool               → None                # no→False→None（挪威问题防御）
269	              值是 str                → 空串→None，否则原样   # "en"→"en"
270	              其他（含 null/None）    → falsy→None，truthy→原样
271	         其他                          → 原样透传             # 裸 true 已是 bool，直接过
272	然后：
273	    字典里出现目标类没有的字段？       → raise ValueError("Unexpected fields ...")
274	最后：目标类(**kwargs) 实例化          # PageResponse.__post_init__ 再做终审
275	```
276	
277	三个「拒绝」出口：缺字段（ValueError）、多字段（ValueError）、实例化时 `__post_init__` 的取值/类型校验（如 `rotation_correction=45` → ValueError；`is_table` 不是 bool → TypeError）。
278	
279	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
280	
281	**字段内省**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:60-61](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L60-L61) 用 `fields(self.front_matter_class)` 构造「字段名 → 类型对象」映射。由于 `PageResponse` 所在的 prompts.py **没有** `from __future__ import annotations`，这里的 `f.type` 是真实的类型对象（`int`、`bool`、`Union[str, None]`），后面 `field_type is int` 这样的恒等比较才能成立——若哪天给 prompts.py 加上字符串化注解，这段代码会悄悄失灵，这是一个值得记住的隐患。
282	
283	**natural_text 特例**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:66-69](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L66-L69) 对 `PageResponse.natural_text` 做特殊处理：它的值不来自 front matter 字典，而来自提取出的**正文**；`text if text else None` 意味着正文为空字符串时 `natural_text` 是 `None` 而不是 `""`（本讲主实践的观察点）。契约上 `natural_text: Optional[str]`，两种合法形态是「有正文」和「None」，空串被归一为 None。
284	
285	**缺字段即拒收**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:71-72](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L71-L72) 检查字典里必须有该字段，否则抛出带字段名的 `ValueError`。这同时覆盖了 4.2 的全部回退场景——提取层给出空字典，到这里第一个字段就报错。
286	
287	**类型转换梯队**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:77-90](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L77-L90) 按声明类型分四路转换，即 4.3.2 流程图那张决策表。两个值得咀嚼的细节：(1) bool 字段的字符串转换只认 `true`（不区分大小写），`"yes"` 会得到 `False`——看似严苛，但裸写的 `yes` 早已被 `yaml.safe_load` 按 YAML 1.1 转成 `True`，会走进这条分支的只有被模型加了引号的值，此时从严是合理选择；(2) `Optional[str]` 分支里 `isinstance(value, bool) → None` 正是对付挪威问题的防御，源码注释原话是 *Handle boolean values that YAML might produce (e.g., 'no' -> False)*——把「语言码被 YAML 吞成布尔」这种脏值清洗成 None，而不是让它漏到下游触发 TypeError。
288	
289	**多余字段即拒收**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:92-98](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L92-L98) 先把 `natural_text` 从期望集合里剔除（因为它来自正文而非字典），再求 `字典键 − 期望键`，非空则抛 `ValueError` 列出多余字段名。模型要是自作主张加个 `confidence: 0.9`，整页拒收重试——这保证了 Dolma 属性向量的字段集合恒定。
290	
291	**实例化终审**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:100](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L100) 用整理好的 `kwargs` 构造目标类；对 `PageResponse` 而言，[olmocr/prompts/prompts.py:75-92](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/prompts/prompts.py#L75-L92) 的 `__post_init__` 再做最后一道把关：`rotation_correction` 必须属于 `{0, 90, 180, 270}`，六个字段逐一 `isinstance` 查类型（u2-l4 已精读）。转换层尽力把值修成正确类型，实在修不好（如 `rotation_correction: 45`，int 转换成功但取值非法）就由这里拦截。

378	### 4.4 双端复用：同一个解析器服务推理与训练
379	
380	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
381	
382	这个解析器有三类消费方：推理流水线（pipeline.py）、训练数据加载器（train/dataloader.py）、bench 的 transformers 运行器（bench/runners/run_transformers.py）。它能被到处复用的前提只有一个——**依赖足够轻**（见 4.1.1）。而它值得被复用的原因更本质：**「markdown + front matter」是 olmOCR 全链路唯一的数据交换格式**。训练时它是磁盘上的标注文件，推理时它是模型的输出，评测时它是候选系统的输出——三个场合需要完全相同的解析语义，否则「训练学的东西」和「推理被验收的东西」会对不上账。
383	
384	更妙的是，dataloader 里还有一个它的**镜像**：`FrontMatterOutputFormat`，方向恰好相反——把 `PageResponse` 序列化回 markdown。两者一逆一正，构成训练目标的生命周期：磁盘 md → 解析成对象 →（清洗、重组）→ 序列化成模型要学的目标文本。
385	
386	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
387	
388	```text
389	推理端（pipeline.py）:
390	  HTTP 响应 message.content ──解析──▶ PageResponse ──▶ PageResult（旋转控制流 / Dolma 属性 / markdown 输出）
391	
392	训练端（train/dataloader.py）:
393	  磁盘 *.md ──读文件──▶ sample["markdown_content"]
394	            ──FrontMatterParser(step)──▶ sample["page_data"] = PageResponse
395	            ──（其他清洗 step，如 LaTeX 归一化）──▶
396	            ──FrontMatterOutputFormat(step)──▶ sample["response"] = 重组后的 "front matter + 正文" 目标串
397	            ──tokenizer──▶ input_ids / labels（u6-l1 主题）
398	
399	评测端（bench/runners/run_transformers.py）:
400	  模型生成文本 ──解析──▶ PageResponse ──▶ bench 断言用的 markdown
401	```
402	
403	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
404	
405	**step 协议**：[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:85-91](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L85-L91) 定义 `PipelineStep` 抽象基类——唯一要求是 `__call__(sample) -> Optional[sample]`（返回 None 表示丢弃该样本）。`FrontMatterParser` 虽然不继承它，但实现了同构的 `__call__`（鸭子类型），所以能插进流水线；[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:170-179](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L170-L179) 的 `__getitem__` 逐个套用 steps，任一步返回 None 就丢弃样本。解析抛异常（如某个 md 缺字段）会在这里冒出来，等效于「坏样本训练时报错」而非静默跳过。
406	
407	**镜像序列化器**：[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:249-266](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L249-L266) 的 `FrontMatterOutputFormat` 是反向操作：断言 `sample["page_data"]` 是 `PageResponse`，用 f-string 拼出 `---\nprimary_language: ...\n...\n---\n正文` 存入 `sample["response"]`，空正文（None 或全空白）拼成空串。注意一个不对称细节：它写出的布尔是 Python 风格 `True`/`False`（f-string 直接格式化 bool），而推理端 `guided_regex` 允许模型写 `true`/`false` 小写——解析层两种都吃得下（4.3 的转换梯队），所以这不构成问题，反而演示了「序列化不必唯一，解析必须宽容而严格」。
408	
409	**配置驱动装配**：[olmocr/train/config.py:413-419](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/config.py#L413-L419) 在训练配置系统里按名字 `"FrontMatterParser"` 把这个 step 实例化并插进 steps 列表（`front_matter_class: PageResponse` 由 YAML 配置指定）。训练 YAML（如 `olmocr/train/configs/v0.2.0/*.yaml`）里反复出现的 `- name: FrontMatterParser` 就是它。

411	**评测端同款用法**：[olmocr/bench/runners/run_transformers.py:124-126](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/bench/runners/run_transformers.py#L124-L126) 对模型生成文本做与 pipeline.py 一模一样的两步调用——保证「训练目标、推理输出、评测输入」三处对同一格式的理解永远一致。

435	
436	**练习 1**：为什么 `FrontMatterParser` 放在 `olmocr/train/` 而不是 `olmocr/prompts/` 或 `olmocr/data/`？
437	
438	**答案**：从「谁最先需要它」看，它是训练数据加载的一环（把磁盘标注 md 变成 `page_data`），所以归入 train 包；但它同时刻意保持零重依赖（模块 docstring 明说），使 pipeline.py 能在轻量安装里 import。这是个务实的妥协：位置跟着首要主人走，约束（不引 numpy/torch/PIL）跟着全部使用方走。若放在 prompts/ 语义上也说得通——毕竟它解析的就是 prompts.py 定义的契约——但「解析 markdown 数据文件」毕竟不是「提示词构造」。
439	
440	**练习 2**：`FrontMatterOutputFormat` 写出 `True`/`False`，而模型推理输出常是 `true`/`false`。为什么这不构成 bug？
441	
442	**答案**：`yaml.safe_load` 同时接受 `True`/`true`/`FALSE` 等形态并统一转成 Python bool，所以解析层天然兼容两种大小写风格；序列化端只需保证「产出的东西自己能解析回来」（4.4.4 的往返实验）。真正需要严格一致的是字段集合与取值域，那由缺字段/多字段检查和 `__post_init__` 把守。

446	**答案**：解析代码本身**不需要改**——字段清单来自 `fields()` 内省，新字段会自动进入「缺字段必查、bool 类型转换」的通用流程。会失效的是所有写死契约的地方：推理端 `guided_regex`（不含新字段 → 模型永远不输出它 → 每页都因缺字段被拒收）、`FrontMatterOutputFormat` 的 f-string、bench 断言、旧数据集的存量 md。这正体现了「内省式解析」的好处（改一处契约，解析免费跟进）和「格式契约是全链路资产」的代价。

464	## 6. 本讲小结
465	
466	- `FrontMatterParser` 是「模型输出字符串 → 结构化 `PageResponse`」的唯一翻译关，靠**轻量依赖**（无 numpy/torch/PIL）同时服务推理、训练、评测、数据整理四个场合。
467	- 提取层 `_extract_front_matter_and_text` 只做三件事：`---\n` 前缀检查、从索引 4 起 `find("\n---")`、两刀切成「YAML 段 / 正文」再 `yaml.safe_load`；一切异常输入统一回退为 `(空字典, 原文)`，把报错权交给组装层。
468	- 组装层 `_parse_front_matter` 用 `dataclasses.fields` 内省出字段与类型，做四路类型转换（int/bool 字符串强转、`Optional[str]` 的挪威问题清洗）、缺字段与多字段双拒绝，最后实例化时由 `__post_init__` 终审取值域。
469	- `natural_text` 是特例：它来自正文而非 front matter，空正文归一为 `None`——「头是 YAML、体是自由文本」是全链路的格式契约。
470	- 生成端的 `guided_regex` 约束 + 解析端的严格校验构成双保险；即便解析失败，`try_single_page` 也只是把该页本次 attempt 记为失败，交给重试机制，流水线不崩。
471	- dataloader 中的 `FrontMatterOutputFormat` 是解析器的镜像（对象 → markdown），两者一逆一正撑起训练目标「解析 → 清洗 → 重组」的生命周期。

# u2-l5 front matter 解析：把模型输出变成结构化数据

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 手写（不借助库）从一段 markdown 顶部提取 YAML front matter 的字符串处理逻辑，并说清每个偏移量的来历。
2. 说清 `_parse_front_matter` 如何用 `dataclasses.fields` 内省字段类型，把一个普通字典逐一转换、校验后组装成 `PageResponse` 实例，以及缺字段、多字段、类型不符时分别会发生什么。
3. 解释为什么这个解析器放在 `olmocr/train/` 包里，却被推理流水线 `pipeline.py`、训练 `dataloader.py`、bench 运行器三处复用——「轻量依赖 + 双重身份（独立工具 / pipeline step）」的设计动机。

本讲是 u2-l4 的直接续篇：上一讲我们知道了模型「被要求」输出什么（提示词 + `PageResponse` 契约），本讲看代码如何把模型实际吐出的字符串「接住」并变成可信的对象。

## 2. 前置知识

- **YAML front matter**：一种从静态博客（Jekyll、Hugo）流行起来的约定——markdown 文件最顶部用一行 `---` 开始、再一行 `---` 结束，中间放一段 YAML 键值对元数据，正文跟在后面。olmOCR 借用这个格式让 VLM 在正文之前汇报页面元信息（语言、旋转、是否表格等）。
- **YAML 的「挪威问题」**：PyYAML 实现的是 YAML 1.1，会把裸写的 `no`、`No`、`NO`、`on`、`off` 等直接解析成布尔值 `False`/`True` 而不是字符串。所以 `primary_language: no`（本意可能是挪威语）到了 Python 里会变成 `False`。本讲会看到 olmOCR 专门为这件事写了防御代码。
- **dataclass 运行时内省**：`dataclasses.fields(SomeClass)` 能在运行时拿到字段名列表和每个字段的类型对象；`typing.get_origin` / `get_args` 能把 `Optional[str]` 拆开看——`get_origin(Optional[str])` 是 `typing.Union`，`get_args(Optional[str])` 是 `(str, NoneType)`。本讲的类型转换逻辑完全建立在这两个内省工具上。
- **`Optional[str]` 的本质**：它就是 `Union[str, None]` 的别名。判断「某个类型注解是不是 Optional[str]」不能靠字符串比较，要靠上面的拆解。
- **pipeline step 模式**：训练数据加载器把「读文件 → 渲染 PDF → 组提示词 → 格式化输出」拆成一串可组合的小步骤，每个步骤是一个实现了 `__call__(sample) -> sample` 的对象，样本字典像流水线上的工件一样被依次加工（详见 u6-l1，本讲只涉及其中一个步骤）。
- 承接 u2-l4：`PageResponse` 是一个 `frozen=True` 的 dataclass，六个字段，`__post_init__` 里做了取值与类型双重校验（`rotation_correction` 只允许 0/90/180/270）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 在本讲中的角色 |
|---|---|
| [olmocr/train/front_matter.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py) | **主角**。`FrontMatterParser` 及其三个核心方法的完整实现，全文仅 121 行。 |
| [olmocr/prompts/prompts.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/prompts/prompts.py) | 提供 `PageResponse` 输出契约（u2-l4 已精读），本讲引用其字段定义与 `__post_init__` 校验。 |

| [olmocr/train/dataloader.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py) | 消费方之二：把 `FrontMatterParser` 当作训练数据 pipeline 的一个 step；还包含它的「镜像序列化器」`FrontMatterOutputFormat`。 |
| [tests/test_dataloader.py](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/tests/test_dataloader.py) | `TestFrontMatterParser` 四个单测，是理解边界行为的最佳材料。 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 FrontMatterParser：一个轻量、双身份的解析器

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

模型输出的原始形态是一整个字符串：顶部 front matter + 正文。而下游需要的是结构化数据——旋转纠错控制流要读 `is_rotation_valid` / `rotation_correction`，Dolma 输出要读 `primary_language` / `is_table` / `is_diagram`，正文本身就是 `natural_text`。`FrontMatterParser` 就是这道「字符串 → 对象」的翻译关。

它的设计有两个关键词：

1. **轻量**。模块 docstring 明说了动机：

   > This module is intentionally kept lightweight (no numpy/torch/PIL) so it can be imported from pipeline.py and other contexts that don't have GPU dependencies.

   见 [olmocr/train/front_matter.py:1-5](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L1-L5)。它只依赖标准库 + `yaml` + `olmocr.prompts.prompts`（后者只 import `re` / `dataclass` / `typing`）。这样推理端（轻量安装、无 torch）也能 import 它。这也是 u1-l4 里说的「train/front_matter 被推理流水线反向复用」那条依赖边的由来。
   
   一个诚实的细节：`PyYAML` 并**没有**列在 [pyproject.toml:22-39](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/pyproject.toml#L22-L39) 的核心依赖里，它通常是随 `vllm`/`transformers` 等 gpu extra 传递安装的。轻量环境跑本讲实践前，若 `import yaml` 报错，先 `pip install pyyaml`。

2. **双身份**。它既能当独立工具用——pipeline.py 直接调它的两个私有方法；也能当训练 dataloader 里的一个 pipeline step 用——把样本字典传给 `__call__`。类 docstring 原话：*Can be used standalone or as a pipeline step in the dataloader.*

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

整体是「两步走 + 一个可选组装」：

```text
模型输出 markdown 字符串
        │
        ▼
① _extract_front_matter_and_text      切字符串 + yaml.safe_load
        │  返回 (front_matter_dict, body_text)
        ▼
② _parse_front_matter                 按目标 dataclass 逐字段转换/校验
        │  front_matter_class=None → 原样返回字典
        │  front_matter_class=PageResponse → 返回 PageResponse 实例
        ▼
下游消费（旋转控制流 / Dolma 属性 / 训练目标文本）
```

作为 pipeline step 时（`__call__`）再多一层包装：

```text
sample 字典 ──▶ 没有 markdown_content 就从 markdown_path 读文件
           ──▶ ① + ②（异常统一包成带文件路径的 ValueError）
           ──▶ sample["page_data"] = 结果，返回 sample
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**类的骨架**——一个 frozen dataclass，唯一的配置项就是目标类：

[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:21-29](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L21-L29) 定义了 `@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)` 的 `FrontMatterParser`，携带一个可选字段 `front_matter_class: Optional[Type] = None`。这段代码声明了解析器的全部可配置面：传 `PageResponse` 就得到强校验的对象，传 `None` 就只做提取、返回普通字典。`frozen` 保证实例不可变（在 asyncio 并发环境里可安全共享），`slots` 省内存。

**推理端的消费现场**——pipeline.py 拿到 HTTP 响应后这三行：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:210-212](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L210-L212) 在 `try_single_page` 内部创建 `FrontMatterParser(front_matter_class=PageResponse)`，先 `_extract_front_matter_and_text(model_response_markdown)`，再 `_parse_front_matter(front_matter, text)`——这就是「独立工具」用法：不走 `__call__`，直接调两个方法。得到的 `page_response` 随后被塞进 `PageResult`（[olmocr/pipeline.py:214-222](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L214-L222)），流向旋转纠错与 Dolma 输出。

**为什么解析几乎不会失败**——推理端在请求里同时开了 `--guided_decoding`：

[olmocr/pipeline.py:179-182](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L179-L182) 把 `guided_regex` 设为一条精确描述输出形状的正则（`---\nprimary_language: (?:[a-z]{2}|null)\n...` 两个字母语言码或 null、布尔四选、旋转度四选、结尾要么封口要么带正文）。也就是说：**生成端用正则约束形状，解析端再用严格校验兜底**，双保险。即便如此，解析仍可能抛异常，而 [olmocr/pipeline.py:228-230](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L228-L230) 的宽 `except Exception` 会把它变成 `return None`——即「本页本次尝试失败」，交给 u2-l6 要讲的重试机制。解析失败不会炸掉整条流水线。

**step 身份的入口**——`__call__`：

[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:102-120](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L102-L120) 实现了 pipeline step 协议：若样本里没有 `markdown_content`，就从 `sample["markdown_path"]` 读文件（已读则不重复读盘）；然后依次调用①②；②抛出的任何异常都被重新包成带文件路径的 `ValueError`（排障时能直接定位到坏文件）；最后只新增一个键 `sample["page_data"]`，把样本传下去。这是典型的「装饰样本」式 step：不改已有字段，只追加。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：在轻量环境（无需 GPU、无需安装 torch）验证这个模块的「轻量」承诺，并跑通两种身份中的独立工具用法。

**操作步骤**（示例代码）：

```python
# practice_4_1.py —— 示例代码（非项目原有文件）
from olmocr.prompts.prompts import PageResponse
from olmocr.train.front_matter import FrontMatterParser

md = """---
primary_language: en
is_rotation_valid: true
rotation_correction: 0
is_table: false
is_diagram: false
---
# Hello

This is the body text with a table and some prose.
"""

parser = FrontMatterParser(front_matter_class=PageResponse)
front_matter, text = parser._extract_front_matter_and_text(md)
print("front_matter =", front_matter)
print("text =", repr(text))

page = parser._parse_front_matter(front_matter, text)
print(type(page))
print(page)
```

**需要观察的现象**：

1. `front_matter` 是一个普通 dict，`text` 是去掉首尾空白的正文。
2. `page` 是 `PageResponse` 实例，打印出的字段值和 front matter 一致，`natural_text` 等于正文。

**预期结果**：`yaml.safe_load` 会把 `true`/`false` 变成 Python 布尔、`0` 变成 int，所以 dict 里已是正确类型；`page.natural_text` 为 `"# Hello\n\nThis is the body text with a table and some prose."`。以上行为均直接来自下文 4.2/4.3 精读的代码，可本地运行验证（轻量环境记得先 `pip install pyyaml`）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`FrontMatterParser` 为什么用 `@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)` 而不是普通类？说出至少两个理由。

**答案**：(1) `frozen` 使实例不可变——解析器配置（要不要转成 PageResponse）在构造后不可篡改，多个 asyncio worker 共享同一个实例时没有竞态；(2) `slots` 让实例不带 `__dict__`，省内存；(3) dataclass 让「一个可选配置字段」用一行声明表达，且能与训练配置系统（u6-l4 的 OmegaConf dataclass 树）自然对接。

**练习 2**：pipeline.py 用解析器时为什么直接调 `_extract_front_matter_and_text` / `_parse_front_matter` 这两个「私有」方法，而不是 `__call__`？

**答案**：`__call__` 的输入是训练样本字典（要求 `markdown_path` 或 `markdown_content` 键，输出追加 `page_data` 键），是为 dataloader 的 pipeline step 协议设计的；推理端手里已有现成的字符串（HTTP 响应里的 `message.content`），不需要读文件、也不需要样本字典这层包装，所以绕过 step 协议直接调用两个核心方法。

**练习 3**：如果解析阶段抛了异常，`try_single_page` 会怎样？

**答案**：被 [olmocr/pipeline.py:228-230](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/pipeline.py#L228-L230) 的 `except Exception` 捕获，记一条 warning 日志并返回 `None`，表示「这一页这次尝试失败」，由上层 `process_page` 按温度阶梯重试或最终走 pdftotext 兜底（u2-l6 主题）。

### 4.2 _extract_front_matter_and_text：字符串切分与 YAML 容错

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

这一步解决的问题是：**从一整个字符串里，把「元数据头」和「正文」切开**。它不用任何 markdown 解析库，纯手工做前缀检查 + 定界符搜索 + 一次 `yaml.safe_load`，总共十几行。理解它的关键是看懂每个魔法数字（4、4）对应的字符偏移。

它还是整条链路的「容错阀」：无论输入是「没有 front matter」「YAML 写坏了」还是「定界符没闭合」，它都不抛异常，而是统一回退成 `(空字典, 整段原文当正文)`——把「报不报错」的决定权交给下一节的 `_parse_front_matter`。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

输入字符串的字符布局（正常情况）：

```text
索引:  0    1    2    3    4 ..................... e ............. e+4
字符:  '-'  '-'  '-'  '\n' 'primary_language: en\n...' '\n' '-' '-' '-' '\n正文...'
      └──── 开启定界符 "---\n" ────┘└────── YAML 内容 ──────┘└─ 关闭定界符 "\n---" ─┘└─正文─┘
                                     content[4:e]                  content[e+4:]
```

流程（对应源码逐行）：

1. 前置判断：字符串必须以 `---\n` 开头（三个减号紧跟换行），否则视为没有 front matter。
2. 从索引 4 起向后找子串 `\n---`，得到结束位置 \( e \)（`find` 返回的是 `\n` 的位置）。找不到则视为没有 front matter。
3. 切分：YAML 段 = \( s[4:e] \)，正文 = \( s[e+4:] \) 再 `.strip()`（+4 是跳过 `\n---` 这四个字符）。
4. `yaml.safe_load(YAML 段) or {}`：解析结果为 `None`（空段）时兜底成空字典。
5. 任何 `yaml.YAMLError`：记 warning，落到统一回退分支。
6. 回退分支（无头/未闭合/YAML 坏）：返回 `({}, 整段原文.strip())`。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:37-53](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L37-L53) 是完整实现：`startswith("---\n")` 做前缀检查；`markdown_content.find("\n---", 4)` 找闭合定界符，搜索起点 4 恰好跳过开头的 `---\n`；两处切片 `[4:end_index]` 与 `[end_index + 4 :]` 分别取出 YAML 文本与正文；`yaml.safe_load(...) or {}` 把空解析兜成空字典；`except yaml.YAMLError` 只捕获 YAML 语法错误（记 warning 后落到函数末尾的回退返回），其余异常照常向外抛。

三个要点：

- **搜索起点为什么是 4**：避免把开头定界符自身牵连进匹配。副作用是「空 front matter」（`---\n` 紧跟 `---\n`）找不到闭合定界符，整体回退为「无 front matter」——后续 `_parse_front_matter` 会因缺字段报错。这是可接受的行为：空元数据本来就不合法。
- **`or {}` 的必要性**：`yaml.safe_load("")` 返回 `None` 而不是 `{}`，不兜底的话下游对它调 `.keys()` 会崩。
- **第一个 `\n---` 即视为结束**：如果 YAML 值内部恰好出现行首 `---`，会被误判为闭合——配合生成端的 `guided_regex` 约束，实际不会发生。

配套单测印证了三种边界（见 [tests/test_dataloader.py:658-712](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/tests/test_dataloader.py#L658-L712)）：正常解析（`test_parse_yaml_front_matter` 断言 `page_data` 是 `PageResponse` 且 `natural_text` 等于正文）；无 front matter 且指定了目标类时报 `ValueError`（`test_no_front_matter`）；YAML 写坏时，不指定目标类的解析器返回空字典而不抛错（`test_malformed_yaml`，`page_data == {}`）——正好演示了「提取层容错、组装层严格」的分工。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不用 `front_matter.py`，亲手写一个等价的提取函数，再用它和原版对拍，体会每个偏移量的含义。

**操作步骤**（示例代码）：

```python
# practice_4_2.py —— 示例代码（非项目原有文件）
import yaml
from olmocr.train.front_matter import FrontMatterParser

def my_extract(s: str):
    if not s.startswith("---\n"):
        return {}, s.strip()
    e = s.find("\n---", 4)
    if e == -1:
        return {}, s.strip()
    fm = yaml.safe_load(s[4:e]) or {}
    return fm, s[e + 4 :].strip()

parser = FrontMatterParser(front_matter_class=None)

cases = {
    "正常": "---\nprimary_language: en\nis_rotation_valid: true\n---\nBody here.",
    "无头部": "Just plain markdown, no front matter.",
    "未闭合": "---\nprimary_language: en\nBody without closing delimiter.",
    "空正文": "---\nprimary_language: en\n---\n",
    "正文里有---": "---\nprimary_language: en\n---\nA\n---\nB",
}

for name, s in cases.items():
    mine = my_extract(s)
    orig = parser._extract_front_matter_and_text(s)
    print(f"{name}: mine={mine}")
    print(f"{'':>10} orig ={orig}")
    assert mine == orig, name
```

**练习 1**：输入是 `---\r\nprimary_language: en\r\n---\r\nBody`（Windows 换行），这个函数返回什么？

**练习 3**：`text = markdown_content[end_index + 4 :].strip()` 里的 `.strip()` 去掉了什么？

**答案**：闭合定界符 `---` 之后、正文之前的那一个换行符（以及正文可能带的首尾空白）。没有它，`natural_text` 会以 `\n` 开头，训练目标和 Dolma 文本里就会混入不一致的空白。

### 4.3 _parse_front_matter：类型转换、严格校验与 PageResponse 组装

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

这一步拿到 `(字典, 正文)`，要把它变成可信的 `PageResponse`。模型输出是「野外数据」：YAML 值可能是字符串 `"90"` 而不是整数、`primary_language` 可能被 YAML 解析成布尔 `False`（挪威问题）、可能少写一个字段、也可能自作主张多写一个字段。这一步就是海关：逐字段查验、必要时强行转换、不合格就整体拒收（抛 `ValueError`/`TypeError`），绝不带病放行。

它对目标类几乎没有硬编码——字段清单和类型都来自 `dataclasses.fields()` 运行时内省，所以换任何 dataclass 都能工作（硬编码的例外只有 `PageResponse` 的 `natural_text` 特例，见下）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

对目标类的每个字段依次执行：

```text
for 字段名, 字段类型 in fields(目标类):
    ├─ 是 PageResponse.natural_text？ → 取正文 text；text 为空串则置 None
    ├─ 字典里没有该字段？             → raise ValueError("Missing required field ...")
    └─ 按字段类型转换字典值：
         int 字段 且 值是 str         → int(value)          # "90" → 90
         bool 字段 且 值是 str        → value.lower()=="true" # "True"→True, "yes"→False
         Optional[str] 字段：
              值是 bool               → None                # no→False→None（挪威问题防御）
              值是 str                → 空串→None，否则原样   # "en"→"en"
              其他（含 null/None）    → falsy→None，truthy→原样
         其他                          → 原样透传             # 裸 true 已是 bool，直接过
然后：
    字典里出现目标类没有的字段？       → raise ValueError("Unexpected fields ...")
最后：目标类(**kwargs) 实例化          # PageResponse.__post_init__ 再做终审
```

三个「拒绝」出口：缺字段（ValueError）、多字段（ValueError）、实例化时 `__post_init__` 的取值/类型校验（如 `rotation_correction=45` → ValueError；`is_table` 不是 bool → TypeError）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**字段内省**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:60-61](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L60-L61) 用 `fields(self.front_matter_class)` 构造「字段名 → 类型对象」映射。由于 `PageResponse` 所在的 prompts.py **没有** `from __future__ import annotations`，这里的 `f.type` 是真实的类型对象（`int`、`bool`、`Union[str, None]`），后面 `field_type is int` 这样的恒等比较才能成立——若哪天给 prompts.py 加上字符串化注解，这段代码会悄悄失灵，这是一个值得记住的隐患。

**natural_text 特例**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:66-69](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L66-L69) 对 `PageResponse.natural_text` 做特殊处理：它的值不来自 front matter 字典，而来自提取出的**正文**；`text if text else None` 意味着正文为空字符串时 `natural_text` 是 `None` 而不是 `""`（本讲主实践的观察点）。契约上 `natural_text: Optional[str]`，两种合法形态是「有正文」和「None」，空串被归一为 None。

**缺字段即拒收**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:71-72](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L71-L72) 检查字典里必须有该字段，否则抛出带字段名的 `ValueError`。这同时覆盖了 4.2 的全部回退场景——提取层给出空字典，到这里第一个字段就报错。

**类型转换梯队**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:77-90](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L77-L90) 按声明类型分四路转换，即 4.3.2 流程图那张决策表。两个值得咀嚼的细节：(1) bool 字段的字符串转换只认 `true`（不区分大小写），`"yes"` 会得到 `False`——看似严苛，但裸写的 `yes` 早已被 `yaml.safe_load` 按 YAML 1.1 转成 `True`，会走进这条分支的只有被模型加了引号的值，此时从严是合理选择；(2) `Optional[str]` 分支里 `isinstance(value, bool) → None` 正是对付挪威问题的防御，源码注释原话是 *Handle boolean values that YAML might produce (e.g., 'no' -> False)*——把「语言码被 YAML 吞成布尔」这种脏值清洗成 None，而不是让它漏到下游触发 TypeError。

**多余字段即拒收**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:92-98](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L92-L98) 先把 `natural_text` 从期望集合里剔除（因为它来自正文而非字典），再求 `字典键 − 期望键`，非空则抛 `ValueError` 列出多余字段名。模型要是自作主张加个 `confidence: 0.9`，整页拒收重试——这保证了 Dolma 属性向量的字段集合恒定。

**实例化终审**：[olmocr/train/front_matter.py:100](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/front_matter.py#L100) 用整理好的 `kwargs` 构造目标类；对 `PageResponse` 而言，[olmocr/prompts/prompts.py:75-92](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/prompts/prompts.py#L75-L92) 的 `__post_init__` 再做最后一道把关：`rotation_correction` 必须属于 `{0, 90, 180, 270}`，六个字段逐一 `isinstance` 查类型（u2-l4 已精读）。转换层尽力把值修成正确类型，实在修不好（如 `rotation_correction: 45`，int 转换成功但取值非法）就由这里拦截。

### 4.4 双端复用：同一个解析器服务推理与训练

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

这个解析器有三类消费方：推理流水线（pipeline.py）、训练数据加载器（train/dataloader.py）、bench 的 transformers 运行器（bench/runners/run_transformers.py）。它能被到处复用的前提只有一个——**依赖足够轻**（见 4.1.1）。而它值得被复用的原因更本质：**「markdown + front matter」是 olmOCR 全链路唯一的数据交换格式**。训练时它是磁盘上的标注文件，推理时它是模型的输出，评测时它是候选系统的输出——三个场合需要完全相同的解析语义，否则「训练学的东西」和「推理被验收的东西」会对不上账。

更妙的是，dataloader 里还有一个它的**镜像**：`FrontMatterOutputFormat`，方向恰好相反——把 `PageResponse` 序列化回 markdown。两者一逆一正，构成训练目标的生命周期：磁盘 md → 解析成对象 →（清洗、重组）→ 序列化成模型要学的目标文本。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
推理端（pipeline.py）:
  HTTP 响应 message.content ──解析──▶ PageResponse ──▶ PageResult（旋转控制流 / Dolma 属性 / markdown 输出）

训练端（train/dataloader.py）:
  磁盘 *.md ──读文件──▶ sample["markdown_content"]
            ──FrontMatterParser(step)──▶ sample["page_data"] = PageResponse
            ──（其他清洗 step，如 LaTeX 归一化）──▶
            ──FrontMatterOutputFormat(step)──▶ sample["response"] = 重组后的 "front matter + 正文" 目标串
            ──tokenizer──▶ input_ids / labels（u6-l1 主题）

评测端（bench/runners/run_transformers.py）:
  模型生成文本 ──解析──▶ PageResponse ──▶ bench 断言用的 markdown
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**step 协议**：[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:85-91](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L85-L91) 定义 `PipelineStep` 抽象基类——唯一要求是 `__call__(sample) -> Optional[sample]`（返回 None 表示丢弃该样本）。`FrontMatterParser` 虽然不继承它，但实现了同构的 `__call__`（鸭子类型），所以能插进流水线；[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:170-179](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L170-L179) 的 `__getitem__` 逐个套用 steps，任一步返回 None 就丢弃样本。解析抛异常（如某个 md 缺字段）会在这里冒出来，等效于「坏样本训练时报错」而非静默跳过。

**镜像序列化器**：[olmocr/train/dataloader.py:249-266](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/dataloader.py#L249-L266) 的 `FrontMatterOutputFormat` 是反向操作：断言 `sample["page_data"]` 是 `PageResponse`，用 f-string 拼出 `---\nprimary_language: ...\n...\n---\n正文` 存入 `sample["response"]`，空正文（None 或全空白）拼成空串。注意一个不对称细节：它写出的布尔是 Python 风格 `True`/`False`（f-string 直接格式化 bool），而推理端 `guided_regex` 允许模型写 `true`/`false` 小写——解析层两种都吃得下（4.3 的转换梯队），所以这不构成问题，反而演示了「序列化不必唯一，解析必须宽容而严格」。

**配置驱动装配**：[olmocr/train/config.py:413-419](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/train/config.py#L413-L419) 在训练配置系统里按名字 `"FrontMatterParser"` 把这个 step 实例化并插进 steps 列表（`front_matter_class: PageResponse` 由 YAML 配置指定）。训练 YAML（如 `olmocr/train/configs/v0.2.0/*.yaml`）里反复出现的 `- name: FrontMatterParser` 就是它。

**评测端同款用法**：[olmocr/bench/runners/run_transformers.py:124-126](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/bench/runners/run_transformers.py#L124-L126) 对模型生成文本做与 pipeline.py 一模一样的两步调用——保证「训练目标、推理输出、评测输入」三处对同一格式的理解永远一致。

**第四个消费现场**（数据整理）：[olmocr/data/repackage_olmocrmix.py:159-167](https://github.com/allenai/olmocr/blob/f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d/olmocr/data/repackage_olmocrmix.py#L159-L167) 在重打包 olmOCR-mix 数据集时也用它解析存量 md。一个 121 行的模块四处服役，这就是「轻量 + 单一职责」的复利。

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
